title: Search inside your scanned documents
description: Open Search, type a word, open a result and see the page.

steps.narration: Here's how to find any document ScanFinder has filed, just by typing a word.
steps.caption: Search your scanned documents

steps.narration: Click Search in the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Search

steps.narration: Type anything that's printed on the document — a supplier, a reference, an amount.
steps.caption: 2. Type a word from the document

steps.narration: Matching documents appear on the left.
steps.caption: Matches appear on the left

steps.narration: Click one to see the page on the right.
steps.caption: 4. Click a result to preview it

steps.narration: That's it — every word on every page is searchable the moment a document is filed.
steps.caption: Every page is searchable
